LESSON: KUSOMA 6.2.1 KUSOMA KWA KINA USHAIRI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: USALAMA BARABARANI Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Mapendekezo ya 
Topic 6.2: Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi
2. kujadili maudhui na dhamira katika shairi
3. kuchambua shairi kwa kuzingatia maudhui na dhamira

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi
   In simple words: practise until you can kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kujadili maudhui na dhamira katika shairi
   In simple words: practise until you can kujadili maudhui na dhamira katika shairi. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. kuchambua shairi kwa kuzingatia maudhui na dhamira
   In simple words: practise until you can kuchambua shairi kwa kuzingatia maudhui na dhamira. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi.
4. Show that you can: kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 6.2.1 Kusoma kwa Kina Ushairi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kueleza maana ya maudhui na dhamira katika fasihi
2. kujadili maudhui na dhamira katika shairi
3. kuchambua shairi kwa kuzingatia maudhui na dhamira

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
